tools.name: save_login
tools.description: Owner only (your Pro key, never a bot key). Store one login sealed with AES-256-GCM, with a scope: allowed hosts, allowed methods, a daily session cap and session TTL. Run it from your own machine, not inside the bot. The password and TOTP secret are never returned by any tool. Free watch-only store

tools.name: list_logins
tools.description: List saved logins (name, domain, scope, sessions today; never secrets). With your owner key it also lists bot keys. A bot key only sees the logins it was granted.

tools.name: delete_login
tools.description: Owner only. Delete a saved login, end its open sessions and remove it from every bot key.

tools.name: create_bot_key
tools.description: Owner only. Make a per-bot key (vk_...) that can only open sessions on the logins you name. Shown once; we store only its hash. Revoke any time with revoke_bot_key.

tools.name: revoke_bot_key
tools.description: Owner only. Revoke a bot key right away and end every session it opened.

tools.name: open_session
tools.description: Sign in with a saved login without seeing it. The server fills {{username}}, {{password}} and {{totp}} into your form, posts it to url (https, inside the login's allowed hosts), keeps the cookies encrypted, and returns an opaque session id. Checked against the login's scope and daily cap; logged to

tools.name: session_fetch
tools.description: Make one request inside an open session. url must be https inside the login's allowed hosts and the method must be in its allowed methods. The password, TOTP secret and codes are redacted from the reply; cookies never leave the vault.

tools.name: end_session
tools.description: End a session now and wipe its cookies.

tools.name: audit_log
tools.description: Owner only. The last uses of your vault: who (bot label), which login, which domain, what happened. Never contains secrets.

tools.name: weekly_report
tools.description: Plain-English summary of the last 7 days: where your bots needed to sign in (by domain), sessions opened, blocked attempts, by bot. Read-only. Needs a key.

tools.name: usage_and_upgrade
tools.description: Show today's usage for your key or IP and the $9/month upgrade link. Free tier: 500 calls/day. Not metered.
